title: Make a plain atrium doctor detect segment mode instead of checking the frozen v1 archive
notes: Observed 2026-11-27 14:29: plain `atrium doctor` ran the v1 checks (archive-schema, index-coverage, synthesis, synthesis-events) and FAILed synthesis-events with '3 conversations absent', while the refresh's own `doctor --publish --segment-inventory` at 14:26:57 reported all 8 checks ok (status/doctor.json).

Cause: run_doctor switches to segment mode only when the caller passes --segment-inventory; atrium-refresh decides that with dotfiles/bin/conversation-segment-mode and $STATE/segment-inventory.json. A person running doctor by hand gets the frozen-world comparison run_doctor's own docstring calls false drift, and the sampled FAIL comes and goes between runs (0 absent earlier the same day).
done_when: atrium doctor with no flags uses the segment inventory when segment mode is on, with a test, and prints the same checks as status/doctor.json
